title: [finding] in `packages/cli` the `--hookTimeout` CLI override is SILENTLY INERT under `test.projects` — the instrument the repo's own prior art uses to WITNESS a cold load leaving the clocked window returns green having measured nothing
body:
Surfaced by the dev delivering #18748 (PR #18782) — ⛔ and it was surfaced *because the dispatching seat handed it this instrument as a suggestion*, which is the part worth recording: the seat proposed a behavioural probe, the deliverer tried it, and **found the probe inert**. ⛔ Filed bare: `finding` only; grading and `domain:*` are triage's.

## The reading, with a LIT control

In `packages/cli`, whose `vitest.config.ts` uses `test.projects`, the `--hookTimeout` CLI override does not reach the project config. Probe: a `beforeAll` sleeping 500ms.

| run | result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit PROBE --hookTimeout=1` | **exit 0**, 1 passed |
| the same without `--project` | **exit 0**, 1 passed |
| ⭐ **lit control** — the same probe body under `@objectstack/plugin-dev` (no `test.projects`): `vitest run PROBE --hookTimeout=1` | **exit 1**, `Error: Hook timed out in 1ms.` |

⇒ the flag works, so the two zeros are **readings**, ⛔ not a dead instrument. vitest `4.1.11`.

## ⚠️ Why this matters well beyond the card it came from

This is the instrument the repo's **own prior art** reaches for to witness that a cold load has left the clocked window — `packages/plugins/plugin-dev/src/dev-plugin-security-enforcement-warning.test.ts` uses exactly this shape. In `packages/cli` it returns **green having measured nothing**.

⭐ So the failure mode is the one this repo keeps naming: **a reading that cannot fail is indistinguishable from one that passed.** A merge-queue triage, or any seat reaching for `--hookTimeout` to decide whether a timeout is a budget problem or a load problem, gets a **false clearance** in this package — and `packages/cli` is precisely where the cold-boot cost lives.

## ⛔ Not asserted

Which side moves — whether vitest's project resolution should honour the flag, whether the repo should stop relying on it, or whether the witness should be written a different way. ⛔ Not fixed on #18782 and ⛔ not fixed here.

Dedupe words: `hookTimeout inert under test.projects` · `vitest CLI timeout override does not reach a project` · `--hookTimeout=1 false green` · `packages/cli vitest projects` · `testTimeout flag swallowed`.

<sub>Dedupe before filing: complete repo-scoped enumeration of **523** open issues (⚠️ REST `/search/*` is 403 for this seat, so enumeration plus local match is the only instrument). `hookTimeout` → 1 (only #18748, its parent), `test.projects` → **0**, `testTimeout` → **0**. Negative control → 0. ⚠️ Adjacent and ⛔ NOT this: **#17658**, which is about a *gate's detector* failing to see a load, not about a *vitest flag* failing to reach a project.</sub>
